workflows.name: Echo Check
workflows.source_request: Build a workflow named echo-check that must gate a greeting is a nonempty string.

workflows.name: Business Presentations
workflows.source_request:
Build a workflow named business-presentations.
- The gate must verify the brief is a nonempty string.
- The gate must verify the storyboard is a nonempty string.
- The gate must verify the speaker notes are a nonempty string.

workflows.name: Research Learn
workflows.source_request:
Build a workflow named research-learn.
- The gate must verify the teach-back report is a nonempty string.
- The gate must verify each claim quotes a string found in a local page file under --pages, or the line is marked unverified.
- The gate must verify an uncited claim fails with the error citations-missing.
- The gate must verify the explainer HTML file exists and contains the topic string.
- The gate must verify the quiz has at least 1 question and a matching answer key.
- The gate must verify the flashcards file is a nonempty string.
- The router must judge only the --request string. A --pages path must not be a forbidden target.
- Fixture mode must pass with the bundled local pages and must not fetch a URL.

workflows.name: Session Brief
workflows.source_request:
Build a workflow named session-brief.
- The gate must verify the brief file exists and is a nonempty string.
- The gate must verify the brief is at most 80 lines.
- The gate must verify every bullet cites a source id or is marked unverified.
- The gate must verify a missing brief file fails with the error brief-missing.
- When --db is set, the workflow must read that sqlite file and write the brief from its session rows.
- Fixture mode must pass without a live database.
- The router must judge only the --request string. A --db path must not be a forbidden target.
